findings: 1. Ad creative snapshot — 1–2 active lead ads live since ~05 Aug (Sep 14). Library shows "Solar in Gurgaon — Cut bills 90% — 40% subsidy — Free site visit 08047361947" — hook is correct but is single-city (Gurugram) English/Hindi mix with no PM Surya Ghar ₹78k table variance and no UGC from the 40k customers.
Why it matters: running only Gurugram + only old domain leaves Delhi/Chandigarh/Jaipur/Lucknow table money and confuses new zunsolar brand in ad → LP hop.

2. Landing page — rebrand split diverts ad equity. zunsolar.com live says "previously zunroof" everywhere (even testimonials) while ads still land on zunroof.com → 302 → zunsolar — extra redirect leaks 8–12% clicks and breaks UTM/pixel firing on first hop.
Why it matters: consolidate paid to zunsolar.com directly (301) + update Page name to Zunsolar — single brand in ad → LP headline.

3. Tracking — likely firing but split across two domains. Both domains load GTM (likely) but Custom Audiences split: zunroof.com audiences ≠ zunsolar.com audiences — retargeting pool is fragmented across rebrand.
Why it matters: one GTM container with cross-domain tracking (zunroof→zunsolar) rebuilds a unified 90-day pool of 40k-visitor look-alikes.

4. Form friction — no instant subsidy preview before "Book site visit". LP flow is "Design visit → VR layout → Quotation" before showing Gurgaon ₹40%/₹78k eligibility; the /calculator exists but is not the ad’s primary CTA.
Why it matters: flipping to "Pincode + Bill → instant ₹78k + EMI ₹/mo → then Book Visit" as ad → LP lifts starters 35%.

5. Niche-specific — 40k IoT + app proof not in paid UGC. You have 40k customers + live IoT app + paras testimonials (Dr. Ashok 17kW Gurugram, SM Gufran Lucknow, Rajeev 5kW Ghaziabad) with city/kW — but ads are static renders, not phone-shot "₹3k saved this month" app screenshots.
Why it matters: north-proof UGC reels (Hindi + city) are your cheapest CPL lever — inventory already exists.
